strategy.current_objective: Get Oak's Parcel from Viridian Poke Mart

waypoints.description: Go to Viridian Poke Mart, get Oak's Parcel
Walk DOWN to exit current building
Deliver parcel to Oak, GET POKÉDEX

strategy.notes: The Pokédex is required for progressing in the game. This path ensures the agent prioritizes getting the parcel and delivering it to Professor Oak before attempting to level up and challenge the Pewter Gym.
